name: mrscraper-cli
description: MrScraper web fetching, structured extraction, Google search, and saved-run workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Fetch pages and extract web data with MrScraper
interface.longDescription: Skills-only Codex plugin for fetching readable page content, extracting structured JSON, discovering pages through Google, and working with saved MrScraper runs. Requires the MrScraper CLI and an API key.
defaultPrompt: Get all listing information from this URL and save the extracted JSON.
Fetch this page as readable Markdown and summarize it.
Search Google for this topic and return the most relevant sources.
